references.matching_note: Catenary space is an arbitrary topological space.
An irreducible closed subset has the irreducibility property in its subspace topology.
The codimension is the chain-length invariant for nested irreducible closed subspaces.

references.phrase: maximal chains of irreducible closed subsets
references.context: Topology: maximal strictly nested chains of irreducible closed subsets between Y and Z
references.reason: The maximal-chain condition is a poset concept and should be compared with other chain contexts.

references.phrase: all maximal chains have the same finite length
references.disposition: This equal-length requirement constitutes the catenary property rather than a separate named prerequisite.

review_rationale: Read catenarity as the equal-length condition on maximal chains of nested irreducible closed subspaces and linked topology and codimension in the correct contexts.
